title: Public README Conformance Repair
notes: README target was checked for required section order, complete L1-01 prompt markers, 5x3 example identity, substantive skill sections, canonical specification links and prohibited bootstrap-state leakage.
Negative controls were executed against mutated README text and each mutation produced at least one validation error.
This verification is structural public-surface validation. It is not an installed-agent test, research benchmark or clean external installation.
